_note: A made-up excerpt of a probe report of add-in 0.12.0: its `families_saved`, one entry for each family name the probe was asked to save (rvt_probe_start's save_families, in that order). A loadable family the model holds under exactly that name is saved as <name>.rfa (Revit 2024 format) and handed back as the output family<n>.rfa, n its place in the list asked; a system family, an in-place family, or a name the model does not hold is reported and not saved. The family names are Revit's own defaults; the bytes and sha256 are those of the made-up stand-in bytes server/test/mock-aps.ts writes. Read by addin/tests through the probe report's contract, by the server's tests through the Autodesk stand-in, and by flo2's own reading of a probe's saved families.

families_saved.why: a system family (Structural Foundations): Revit holds its types in the model itself, and a system family is never saved as a family file (.rfa); an edit's add_wall_footing places a wall footing of a type the model holds
the model holds no family named exactly "Footing-Round" (case and spaces count); it holds one named "Footing-round"
an in-place family: it is modelled in this model alone, so Revit opens no family document for it and it cannot be saved as a family file (.rfa)
